Petitioner/Appellant(s)
 Through:- Mr. K.L. Pandita, Advocate
V/s K.H. Rizvi and others
..... Respondent(s)
Through:- Mr. S.S. Nanda, Sr. AAG  Ms. Nazia Fazal, Advocate vice  Mrs. Monika Kohli, Sr. AAG CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD CHATTERJI KOUL, JUDGE  ORDER 03.06.2024 1.

This application has been moved by the petitioners for impleading Mr. Shahid Iqbal Choudhary,
present Commissioner/Secretary Rural Development Department as party respondent as he has joined in place of Ms. Mandeep Kaur.
2. For the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed.

Mr. Shahid Iqbal Choudhary,
Commissioner/Secretary Rural Development Department is substituted as party respondent.
3. Application is, accordingly, disposed of.
1. The judgment passed way back in 2016 in writ petition has not been implemented in letter and spirit till date.

By allowing the petition, the respondents were directed to follow the procedure laid down under Land Acquisition Act and award compensation to petitioners for compulsory acquisition of land being subject matter of the petition.
Respondents were also held bound to compensate the petitioners for user of the subject matter since 1953.

Respondents were given liberty to handover the possession of the land in question if same was not needed for public purpose within Sham Lal And Another vs K.H. Rizvi And Others on 3 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/105768986/

sentences.text: a period of three months.
2. Since 2016 till date, the respondents have failed to comply with the judgment.

They submit that the land in question is no more required for public purpose, therefore, returned back to the petitioners, however, the respondents were to compensate the petitioners for user of the subject matter since 1953.

3. Neither the compensation has been determined for user of the land from 1953 till the land was handed over to the petitioners nor compensation is paid, which is in clear violation of the judgment passed by this Court.
Respondents were granted number of opportunities since 2017, but have failed to comply with the judgment.

4. Initially, Mr. S.S. Nanda, learned Sr. AAG submits that determination of compensation is a job of Collector who is represented by another counsel but later on submitted that he would ensure that judgment is implemented and compensation determined shall be paid to the petitioners in terms of the judgment within a period of four weeks.
(VINOD CHATTERJI KOUL) JUDGE Jammu 03.06.2024
